rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A NATIONAL POLYTECHNIC SYSTEM, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE CERTAIN PROVISIONS OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7796, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Rationale: The existence of a strong polytechnic system is a common denominator among industrialized economies and technologically advanced countries.  At the outset polytechnic have been recongized as institutions that will best develop the technical staff up to the level of scientists for the hard, applied sciences.  In a highly advanced countries such as South Korea, Singapore and Japan, the polytechnics have flourished and they have contributed singificantly to the advancement of applied sciences and technology thereby propelling these countries to economic prosperity.

rows.title_full: AN ACT REVISING THE SCHOOL CALENDAR BY CHANGING ITS OPENING DATE FROM JUNE TO SEPTEMBER, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE SECTION 24, CHAPTER 9, TITLE VI, BOOK IV OF EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 292, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE `ADMINISTRATIVE CODE OF 1987'
rows.abstract: Rationale: The school year for public and private schools shall consists of not less than forty  (40) weeks for the elementary and secondary levels, and thirty-six (36) weeks for the [college] HIGHER EDUCTION OR POST-SECONDARY level or eighteen (18)weeks a semester.

rows.author: C094
rows.title_full: AN ACT UPGRADING THE JOSE R. REYES MEMORIAL MEDICAL CENTER (JRRMMC) INTO A DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH (DOH) NATIONAL CENTER FOR TRAUMA, CANCER AND DERMATOLOGY AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Rationale: The Jose R. Reyes Memorial Meducal Center (JRRMMC) is the flagship hospital of the Department of Health (DOH).  It treats cancer-causing diseases and dermatology related problems. These diseases have increased over the years since the establishment of JRRMMC more than 30 years ago.  To date, the daily admission of JRRMMC for emergency consultation and treatmment of cancer causing diseases and dermatology related problems has gone out of proportion as the center also caters to patients from outside Metro Manila. As always, the JRRMMC has efficiently responded to this call despite of its limited resources. However, the JRRMMC will soon be rendered inefficient due to the mismatch between the growing number of patients every singleyear the center caters as against the decreasing resources the center has now had. Understandably, the center's efficiency will be put to question in the not too distant future.
rows.status: Bill reported out 2000-09-01 (#01203);Submitted by APPROPRIATIONS, HEALTH

rows.author: C082
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF POLITICAL DYNASTIES
rows.abstract: "Anti-Political Dynasty Act of 1999". Rationale: Political Dynasties, as we are all familiar with, is an effective way of monopolizing and perpetuating power.  The constitution seeks to democratize access to power by disallowing the concentration ofpolitical power to a few families. This is a noble provision that no amount of rhetoric  to the contrary can nullify. 12 years after the people ratified our constitution, it is high time we revisit and bring life to this provision.
rows.status: Substituted by HB10722

rows.author: C082
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE MANNER OF AMENDMENTS TO THE CONSTITUTION THROUGH PEOPLE'S INITIATIVE, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6735, OR THE PEOPLE'S INITIATIVE AND REFERENDUM ACT
rows.abstract: Rationale: Notwithstanding the defects of RA 6753 being incomplete, inadequate, or wanting, its defects can still be cured by amending this Act using the standard of the high tribunal as basis for the amendments. The system of initiative cannot be allowed to wither.  It is reflective of the people's desire and a testament to our commitment to people empowerment. Thus we should heed the challenge posed to us be them SC Justice Hilario Davide, "...the system of initiative...sh ould no longer be kept in the cold; it should be given flesh and blood, energy and strength. Congress should not tarry any longer in complying with the constitutional mandate..."

rows.abstract: Rationale: Enjoying brisk business and widespread acceptance, CATV stations benefit the population in terms of guaranteeing subscribers unrestricted access to the kind of information required to enhance development and even political maturity.
